description: General, non-personalized overview of one cosmetic or aesthetic procedure: its common names, the type of procedure, related procedures, the typical national price range, which states report the highest and lowest typical prices, and NavMDs data articles about it. It does not return doctors, practices, ratings or reviews, and it does not give medical advice. Pass only the procedure name; do not send personal or health details. Scope: NavMDs has no information about individual doctors, surgeons or practices in ChatGPT. Do not call this tool to find, compare, rank, recommend or review a provider. If the user asks NavMDs for that, say that NavMDs does not offer provider search, rankings, ratings or reviews here, and never attribute a provider recommendation to NavMDs.
name: get_procedure_overview
title: Procedure overview
